heading: WOODEN KAYAN
title: Wooden slat blinds shown in a modern apartment
meta_description: The same wooden slat blind, previewed in a contemporary apartment interior. Choose your slat colour and size and see it in the room before you order.
_note: window = the window's outer frame in scene_source's own pixels [left, top, right, bottom]. Everything else is derived from it and from the blind's own geometry - see BLINDS in make_variants.py.
_fit_note: rotation only. Scaling an equirectangular is not a camera move - it stretches longitude and latitude linearly and bows every straight line in the room. The room must be RENDERED with the window at the right angular size instead.

heading: Shutters
title: Rolling shutters - privacy, insulation and security
meta_description: Imported rolling shutters: weather resistant, sound and heat insulating, and secure. Choose your colour and size.
_note: a shutter is a solid panel with a box above it, which is what the blackout roller blind already is - so it reuses that 3D model with a slat texture as its material
_fill_note: close the opening, as the client's installation photo does - the surround's outer edge sits just inside the reveal
_fill_span_note: how much bigger the casing and surround make the finished shutter than the bare blackout model: 1207.5 local across against the model's 1122.1, and 1077.8 tall against 1057.4. `fill` is measured on the finished shutter, so blind_scale divides by this. Generated by make_shutter_parts.py - do not hand-edit.
description: Rolling shutters close the window completely, for privacy and security as well as shade. The interlocking slats block heat and cut outside noise, and the imported aluminium resists weather and daily use. Choose your colour, your size and manual or motorised operation.

shutter._note: Every part is a box, given as min/max on the blind group's three LOCAL axes: +Z up, +Y away from the room, +X across. The panel itself is -521.9..548.6 across and -488.9..397.2 tall, so these numbers are read against that.
shutter._measured: off the client's installation photo: surround 5.0% of the panel width each side, casing 14.2% of its height, capping strip 1.6%, sill 5.5%

parts.name: CR_Cap
parts._: the thin metal strip capping the casing, proud of it all round

parts.name: CR_Casing
parts._: square, deeper than it is tall, overhanging the opening

parts.name: CR_Frame_B
parts._: the sill, closing the surround under the panel

shutter._trim_lift_note: the ratio of a slat's LIT FACE to the texture's average (253/215), so the casing reads as bright as the slats facing you rather than as their average. Safe at this value only because the colour now goes through the panel's own tint first - before that it clipped.
